supersedes: the selections of lidds-evaluation-v3 amendments 1 and 2 (their outputs are still written and reported, not used to choose)
registered_at: see the git commit that adds this file (31/10 evening, +0700)
registered_before: the LID-DS 2021 and CB-DS reruns with alarm times finish, and before any time-horizon result (development, official or CB-DS) is read; the unit lidds-v3-window will also write the amendment 1 output, which is not read before this selection is done
owner_decisions: 31/10: the extended Pulse is the system to bring live
31/10: choose the branches optimally on LID-DS 2021 and CB-DS first
31/10: LID-DS 2019 is the last dataset and runs last, after the live run (this replaces the v3 rule that put LID-DS 2019 before the probe work)
31/10: priority, the configuration brought live keeps the LID-DS 2021 result (97.5 % recall, 1.47 % false alarms on official) or does better
seen_before_registration: every v1, v2 and v3 result on LID-DS 2021 (development and official, per scenario, per recording, per-recording vote), every v1 and v2 result and the per-recording v3 vote on CB-DS, the development-only leave-one-branch-out of the v3 vote, the Juice-Shop development diagnosis
configuration: fires at a window end t when at least k branches of a voting set S have an alarm window ending in (t - H, t], or, with tripwire_alone, whenever the tripwire alarms

search_space.S: every subset of {system, path, errno, bytes, ngram} with at least 2 branches (26)

selection: LID-DS 2021 development (v2 development attacks + v3 30 % of test/normal), from the rerun with alarm times (lidds-evaluation-v3 amendment 1, checked recording by recording against the v2 receipt)
CB-DS, every recording, from a rerun of the v2 branches with alarm times (same conversion; checked against the cbds-confirmation-v1 receipt recording by recording)
data.last: LID-DS 2019 (lidds2019-confirmation-v1 data), after the live run

constraints.lidds2021_development_latency_p95: <= 3.0 s (Pulse goal: kernel to alert <= 3 s)

objective: the highest LID-DS 2021 development recall; ties to fewer development false alarms, then fewer new probe hooks (path, errno, bytes, ngram one each; system none), then the shorter horizon, then the smaller k, then without tripwire_alone

criteria_official.owner_keep_or_better: recall >= 97.5 % and false-alarm recordings <= 1.47 % (the v3 per-recording result)

if_owner_criterion_fails: reported as is; the official data is not used to choose again; a later version may choose on development again, with LID-DS 2019 as its only unseen check
selection_bias: 750 configurations on 544 development attack and 3,403 development normal recordings: the selected development numbers are optimistic; the official numbers are the estimate
next: if H1 holds: implement the selected branches in the probe and user space, measure overhead, a blind live run against the stable system on the same data; then LID-DS 2019 once
